import json
import signal
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.common.action_chains import ActionChains
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
settings = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
driver = None
def deadline(signum, frame):
    raise TimeoutError('Planning browser exceeded 50 seconds')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, deadline)
signal.alarm(50)
try:
    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
    options.binary_location = '/usr/bin/chromium'
    for option in ['--headless=new', '--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--window-size=1440,1200']:
        options.add_argument(option)
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'), options=options)
    driver.set_page_load_timeout(8)
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 6)
    driver.get(settings['url'])
    name, value = settings['cookie'].split('=', 1)
    driver.add_cookie({'name': name, 'value': value, 'path': '/'})
    driver.execute_cdp_cmd('Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument', {'source': '''
      const originalFetch=window.fetch.bind(window);
      window.fetch=(url,options)=>{
        const result=originalFetch(url,options);
        if(window.planningHold&&String(url).includes(window.planningHold)&&options?.method===window.planningMethod){
          return result.then(response=>new Promise(resolve=>{window.planningHeld=true;window.planningRelease=()=>resolve(response);}));
        }
        return result;
      };
      const NativeXHR=window.XMLHttpRequest;
      window.uploadReleases={};
      window.XMLHttpRequest=class extends NativeXHR {
        open(method,url,...rest){this.planningUrl=String(url);return super.open(method,url,...rest);}
        send(body){
          const loaded=this.onload;
          this.onload=event=>{
            if(window.uploadHold&&this.planningUrl.includes(window.uploadHold)){
              window.uploadHeld=true;window.uploadReleases[this.planningUrl]=()=>loaded.call(this,event);
            }else loaded.call(this,event);
          };
          return super.send(body);
        }
        abort(){super.abort();this.onabort?.();}
      };
    '''})
    driver.refresh()
    def route(path):
        driver.execute_script('location.hash=arguments[0]', path)
    def button(text):
        return wait.until(lambda browser: next((item for item in browser.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, 'button') if item.text.strip() == text and item.is_enabled()), False))
    def named(name):
        return wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[name="' + name + '"]'))
    def field_value(name, value):
        return wait.until(lambda browser: named(name).get_attribute('value') == value)
    def type_name(name, value):
        control = named(name)
        control.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL, Keys.BACKSPACE)
        control.send_keys(value)
    def api(method, path, body=None):
        return driver.execute_async_script('''
          const [method,path,body,done]=arguments;
          fetch('/api/v1'+path,{method,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','X-Crew-Request':'1'},body:body==null?undefined:JSON.stringify(body)})
            .then(async response=>done({status:response.status,data:await response.json()})).catch(error=>done({error:error.message}));
        ''', method, path, body)
    if settings['mode'] == 'planning':
        route('/projects/' + settings['projectId'] + '/settings')
        field_value('name', 'First planning project')
        type_name('name', 'Local project draft')
        assert api('PATCH', '/projects/' + settings['projectId'], {'name': 'Remote project saved'})['status'] == 200
        button('Refresh planning view').click()
        wait.until(lambda browser: 'Saved project settings changed' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
        field_value('name', 'Local project draft')
        button('Load latest version').click()
        wait.until(lambda browser: browser.switch_to.alert).accept()
        field_value('name', 'Remote project saved')
        type_name('name', 'Pending old resource save')
        driver.execute_script('window.planningHold=arguments[0];window.planningMethod="PATCH";', '/projects/' + settings['projectId'])
        button('Save project and workflow').click()
        wait.until(lambda browser: browser.execute_script('return window.planningHeld===true'))
        route('/projects/' + settings['otherId'] + '/settings')
        field_value('name', 'Second planning project')
        type_name('name', 'New resource draft')
        driver.execute_script('window.planningHold=null;window.planningRelease();')
        field_value('name', 'New resource draft')
        assert 'Project and workflow saved' not in driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
        route('/projects/' + settings['projectId'] + '/board')
        source = wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="board-card-' + settings['issueId'] + '"]'))
        destination = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="board-column-' + settings['activeId'] + '"] header')
        driver.execute_script('arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block:"center"});', source)
        ActionChains(driver).move_to_element(source.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'small')).click_and_hold().move_by_offset(12, 0).perform()
        ActionChains(driver).send_keys(Keys.ESCAPE).release().perform()
        assert api('GET', '/issues/' + settings['issueId'])['data']['issue']['statusId'] != settings['activeId']
        source = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="board-card-' + settings['issueId'] + '"]')
        ActionChains(driver).move_to_element(source.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'small')).click_and_hold().pause(.1).move_to_element(destination).pause(.2).release().perform()
        wait.until(lambda browser: api('GET', '/issues/' + settings['issueId'])['data']['issue']['statusId'] == settings['activeId'])
        wait.until(lambda browser: browser.execute_script("""return document.querySelector('[data-testid="board-card-'+arguments[0]+'"]')?.closest('[data-status-id]')?.dataset.statusId""", settings['issueId']) == settings['activeId'])
        second = wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="board-card-' + settings['secondCard'] + '"]'))
        target = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-testid="board-card-' + settings['issueId'] + '"]')
        ActionChains(driver).move_to_element(second.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'small')).click_and_hold().pause(.1).move_to_element(target).pause(.2).release().perform()
        wait.until(lambda browser: api('GET', '/issues/' + settings['secondCard'])['data']['issue']['statusId'] == settings['activeId'])
        route('/projects/' + settings['projectId'] + '/settings')
        field_value('name', 'Pending old resource save')
        wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.workflow-row')) == 3)
        rows = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.workflow-row')
        rows[0].find_element(By.XPATH, './/button[normalize-space()="Remove"]').click()
        wait.until(lambda browser: 'Blocked: move these issues' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
        assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Save project and workflow"]').is_enabled()
        route('/projects/' + settings['otherId'] + '/settings')
        field_value('name', 'Second planning project')
        route('/projects/' + settings['projectId'] + '/settings')
        field_value('name', 'Pending old resource save')
        wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.workflow-row select')) == 3)
        from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import Select
        Select(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.workflow-row select')[1]).select_by_value('done')
        check = wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.XPATH, '//label[contains(., "I reviewed these category changes")]/input'))
        assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Save project and workflow"]').is_enabled()
        check.click()
        button('Save project and workflow').click()
        wait.until(lambda browser: 'Project and workflow saved' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
        route('/sprints/' + settings['sprintId'])
        field_value('name', 'First sprint')
        type_name('name', 'Unsaved sprint draft')
        driver.execute_script('window.planningHeld=false;window.planningHold=arguments[0];window.planningMethod="POST";', '/sprints/' + settings['sprintId'] + '/start')
        button('Start sprint').click()
        wait.until(lambda browser: browser.switch_to.alert).accept()
        wait.until(lambda browser: browser.execute_script('return window.planningHeld===true'))
        route('/sprints/' + settings['nextSprintId'])
        field_value('name', 'Next sprint')
        driver.execute_script('window.planningHold=null;window.planningRelease();')
        field_value('name', 'Next sprint')
        assert 'Sprint started' not in driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
    elif settings['mode'] == 'upload':
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            old_file = Path(temp) / 'old-resource.txt'
            new_file = Path(temp) / 'new-resource.txt'
            cancel_file = Path(temp) / 'cancel-resource.txt'
            old_file.write_bytes(b'old complete bytes')
            new_file.write_bytes(b'new complete bytes')
            cancel_file.write_bytes(b'cancel complete bytes')
            route('/issues/' + settings['issueId'] + '/attachments')
            control = wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'input[type="file"]'))
            control.send_keys(str(old_file))
            driver.execute_script('window.uploadHold=arguments[0];window.uploadHeld=false;', '/issues/' + settings['issueId'] + '/attachments')
            button('Upload attachment').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: browser.execute_script('return window.uploadHeld===true'))
            route('/issues/' + settings['otherIssueId'] + '/attachments')
            wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-attachment-issue="' + settings['otherIssueId'] + '"]'))
            control = wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'input[type="file"]'))
            assert control.get_attribute('value') == ''
            assert 'old-resource.txt uploaded' not in driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
            driver.execute_script('window.uploadHold=null;')
            control.send_keys(str(new_file))
            button('Upload attachment').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: 'new-resource.txt uploaded' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
            driver.execute_script('Object.values(window.uploadReleases).forEach(release=>release());')
            assert 'new-resource.txt uploaded' in driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
            assert 'old-resource.txt uploaded' not in driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
            control = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'input[type="file"]')
            control.send_keys(str(cancel_file))
            driver.execute_script('window.uploadHold=arguments[0];window.uploadHeld=false;', '/issues/' + settings['otherIssueId'] + '/attachments')
            button('Upload attachment').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: browser.execute_script('return window.uploadHeld===true'))
            button('Cancel upload').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: 'Upload cancelled' in browser.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text)
            driver.execute_script('Object.values(window.uploadReleases).forEach(release=>release());')
            assert 'cancel-resource.txt uploaded' not in driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
    else:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            paths = []
            for name in ['queue-first.txt', 'queue-second.txt', 'queue-cancel.txt', 'queue-old-pending.txt', 'queue-new-resource.txt']:
                path = Path(temp) / name
                path.write_bytes(('exact bytes for ' + name).encode())
                paths.append(str(path))
            route('/issues/' + settings['issueId'] + '/attachments')
            control = wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'input[type="file"][multiple]'))
            control.send_keys('\n'.join(paths[:2]))
            button('Start queued uploads').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-queue-status="succeeded"]')) == 2)
            assert len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.attachment-queue code')) == 2
            driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'input[type="file"][multiple]').send_keys('\n'.join(paths[2:4]))
            driver.execute_script('window.uploadHold=arguments[0];window.uploadHeld=false;', '/issues/' + settings['issueId'] + '/attachments')
            button('Start queued uploads').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: browser.execute_script('return window.uploadHeld===true'))
            button('Cancel current and pause queue').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-queue-status="cancelled"]')) == 1)
            assert len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-queue-status="pending"]')) == 1
            driver.execute_script('window.uploadHeld=false;')
            button('Start queued uploads').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: browser.execute_script('return window.uploadHeld===true'))
            route('/issues/' + settings['otherIssueId'] + '/attachments')
            wait.until(lambda browser: browser.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-attachment-issue="' + settings['otherIssueId'] + '"]'))
            assert len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-queue-name]')) == 0
            driver.execute_script('window.uploadHold=null;Object.values(window.uploadReleases).forEach(release=>release());')
            driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'input[type="file"][multiple]').send_keys(paths[4])
            button('Start queued uploads').click()
            wait.until(lambda browser: len(browser.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-queue-status="succeeded"]')) == 1)
            assert len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[data-queue-name="queue-new-resource.txt"]')) == 1
    print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': settings['mode'], 'browser': driver.capabilities['browserVersion']}))
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver:
        driver.quit()
